mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, username, nickname, phone, email, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, status, role, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM user ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user SET role = #{role}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE user
username = #{username},
nickname = #{nickname},
phone = #{phone},
email = #{email},
avatar_url = #{avatarUrl},
gender = #{gender},
bio = #{bio},
birthday = #{birthday},
coins = #{coins},
level = #{level},
exp = #{exp},
vip_id = #{vipId},
online_status = #{onlineStatus},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
